value.name: Claire silently acknowledges sedated
value.description: Claire hears the word "sedated" and does not react, signaling an unspoken response to Asha.
evidence: Claire's hand was still folded into her lap; she watched Asha's mouth shape the word sedated and did not flinch, which was its own kind of answer.

value.name: Asha records contact details
value.description: Asha writes the contact name and the status "sedated" onto the pad after hearing them from the clerk.
evidence: The clerk's voice gave Asha the contact name and the word sedated, and she wrote both onto the pad in the same even hand

value.name: Asha separates notes from Claire
value.description: Asha slides the page toward herself so the writing is no longer between her and Claire.
evidence: then slid the page toward herself across the wood so that the writing sat under her wrist instead of between her and Claire

value.name: Rosa urges immediate updates
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's text instructing her to clear the board and report the contact name and status without gaps because they are waking up.
evidence: Her phone buzzed again at her jaw with Rosa's last text—clear the board, contact name and status now, no gaps, they're waking up—

value.name: Asha checks the stair landing
value.description: Asha glances toward the stairs and listens for movement, but hears nothing further.
evidence: She glanced once at the stair landing, where the runner met the bottom step in the same pale strip of hallway light, and listened for a second floorboard that did not come.

value.name: Asha requests unit contact details
value.description: Asha tells the clerk she needs the direct line to the unit and the attending physician's name for tonight.
evidence: Into the phone she said, quieter than before, that she would need the direct line to the unit and the name of the attending on tonight

value.name: Asha shields Claire from deciding
value.description: Asha keeps her eyes on the page while speaking so Claire will not have to decide whether to look at her yet.
evidence: and she kept her eyes on the page while she said it, so that Claire, across the table with her hands folded in her lap, would not have to decide yet whether to look at her.

value.name: Asha writes direct line and attending name
value.description: Asha notes the direct line and attending physician's name on the pad in cramped handwriting.
evidence: Asha wrote the direct line and the attending's name onto the pad in the same cramped print

value.name: Asha asks for room number
value.description: Asha continues the call by asking the clerk for the room number.
evidence: then drew the page fully beneath her wrist and asked the clerk, in the same low pitch, for the room number.
